headline: Shanghai Masters final: Davidovich Fokina beats Jodar 1-6, 7-6(5), 6-4
whyCareReason: The ATP final was an all-Spanish match. Zverev and Medvedev both lost their semifinals.
teaser: Alejandro Davidovich Fokina, seeded 25th, beat Rafael Jodar 1-6, 7-6(5), 6-4 in 2 hours 27 minutes.
story: The ATP results page lists the Rolex Shanghai Masters final on Sunday 18 October as finished in 2 hours 27 minutes on Stadium Court. Alejandro Davidovich Fokina, the 25th seed, beat Rafael Jodar, the 12th seed, 1-6, 7-6(5), 6-4. Umpire: Greg Allensworth. Saturday's semifinals: Davidovich Fokina beat Alexander Zverev 5-7, 6-4, 6-3, and Jodar beat Daniil Medvedev 6-3, 6-4. Zverev remains the year-end world No. 1. The slug of this card is unchanged so the old URL still opens.
stakes: A Masters 1000 title. Jodar, 20, was the youngest Shanghai finalist and was playing his first Masters 1000 final.
rivalryAngle: An all-Spanish final after the two seeded semifinalists both lost on Saturday.
funFacts: Final: Davidovich Fokina d. Jodar 1-6, 7-6(5), 6-4 in 2:27. Umpire Greg Allensworth.
Semifinals: Fokina d. Zverev 5-7, 6-4, 6-3. Jodar d. Medvedev 6-3, 6-4.
Zverev is still the year-end No. 1. Jodar began the year ranked 168th and is now 13th.
